atAGlance: Cháo vịt is duck rice porridge, usually with ginger, scallion, shredded duck, and sometimes cabbage salad.
whatItIs: Cháo vịt is duck rice porridge, often served with sliced duck, herbs, rau răm, ginger fish sauce, and sometimes cabbage salad.
howToEnjoy: Eat the porridge warm, then dip duck pieces lightly in ginger fish sauce. Add pepper or herbs after tasting the broth.
howLocalsOrder: Order cháo vịt when you want duck in a comforting bowl. Ask for ginger fish sauce on the side or less pepper if you want a gentler meal.
worthKnowing: In Vietnam, the side herbs and ginger dip are part of the duck-porridge rhythm, not extras.
goodToKnow: Duck porridge is richer than chicken porridge. Ginger fish sauce wakes up the duck, so add it gradually if you want the bowl to stay mellow.
commonOptions: ginger fish sauce on the side

orderLine.vietnamese: Cho tôi một tô cháo vịt.
orderLine.english: I’d like one bowl of duck rice porridge.
